verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas documents a comprehensive Editor API for scene manipulation, asset management, and custom tooling, a REST API, and an MCP server that lets AI agents modify project data and verify results in the viewport — strongly suggesting API parity with UI actions. However, REST API access is gated behind paid plans, some UI-only features (real-time multi-user collaboration, drag-and-drop asset upload) aren't clearly exposed via API, and community feedback notes friction around local/offline workflows outside the browser UI. Missing for 10: explicit documentation confirming full feature parity between API and UI, independent/hands-on verification that all UI actions are scriptable, and clarity on whether collaboration/checkpoint features are API-accessible.
